component.name: MainScene
component.script:
sub init() m.rounds = 20 m.round = 0 m.reports = 0 m.dups = 0 m.tasks = [] m.timer = createObject("roSGNode", "Timer") m.timer.duration = 0.001 m.timer.repeat = true m.timer.observeField("fire", "onFire") m.timer.control = "start" end sub
' Launches from a Timer observer: if it fires inside the render loop's frame-cap wait, ' flushFanouts() hands the post-RUN write to the slot before checkTaskRun's replay sweep. sub onFire() if m.round >= m.rounds m.timer.control = "stop" return end if m.round++ t = createObject("roSGNode", "WorkerTask") t.observeField("report", "onReport") t.control = "run" t.request = "r" + m.round.toStr() m.tasks.push(t) end sub
sub onReport(event as object) data = event.getData() m.reports++ if data.split(",").count() <> 1 then m.dups++ print "TASK SAW: ["; data; "]" if m.reports = m.rounds print "ROUNDS=" + m.rounds.toStr() + " DUPLICATED=" + m.dups.toStr() m.top.done = true end if end sub
